verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a REST API for setting up and scaling data pipelines and managing the account programmatically. It publishes a full OpenAPI 3.0.1 v1 spec from which the API reference is generated, and its official MCP server exposes read, write and delete scopes, so broad programmatic control exists. However, no evidence claims or demonstrates UI-to-API parity, and several capabilities are documented only through dashboard tabs (Proxy Agent, Hybrid Deployment Agents, Quickstart data models). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage mapping, evidence that dashboard-only features such as agent management and Quickstart models are API-accessible, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Set up and scale your data pipeline, and manage your Fivetran account programmatically using the Fivetran REST API.
Fivetran publishes a dedicated "OpenAPI Definition (V1)" page with direct JSON and YAML downloads of the full REST API specification, from which the API reference is auto-generated.
Set `FIVETRAN_SCOPE` to `read/write` or `read/write/delete` to unlock write and delete operations
